intro.title: Jasper Bracelets
intro.descriptionHtml: Lovely Jasper Bracelets, made from natural Jasper Gemstone, in adorable designs with various bead shapes. Colours like Red, Green, Brown, Yellow Jasper beads in Rectangular, Elliptical etc. shapes look attractive. The interesting Picture Jasper looks striking as bracelets with Silver accessories, the Multicolor Cushion shape bead Bracelet looks fascinating. Wearing the Jasper Bracelets releases stress, brings nurturing qualities, absorbs negative energies, balances the male and female aspects of self, calms the mind etc.
